versos.grego: Ἐν ἔτει δὲ πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ τῆς ἡγεμονίας Τιβερίου Καίσαρος, ἡγεμονεύοντος Ποντίου Πειλάτου τῆς Ἰουδαίας, καὶ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Γαλιλαίας Ἡρῴδου, Φιλίππου δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος χώρας, καὶ Λυσανίου τῆς Ἀβιληνῆς τετρααρχοῦντος,

controles.web: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
controles.kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
controles.livre: No ano quinze do império de Tibério César, sendo Pôncio Pilatos o governador da Judeia, Herodes tetraca da Galileia, e seu irmão Filipe o tetrarca da Itureia e da província de Traconites, e Lisânias o tetrarca de Abilene;

versos.grego: ἐπὶ ἀρχιερέως Ἄννα καὶ Καϊάφα, ἐγένετο ῥῆμα Θεοῦ ἐπὶ Ἰωάνην τὸν Ζαχαρίου υἱὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.

controles.web: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
controles.kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
controles.livre: sendo Anás e Caifás os sumos sacerdotes, a palavra de Deus veio a João, filho de Zacarias, no deserto.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν περίχωρον τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν,

controles.web: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
controles.kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
controles.livre: Ele percorreu toda a região ao redor do Jordão, pregando o batismo de arrependimento, para o perdão dos pecados;

versos.grego: ὡς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ λόγων Ἡσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet,  “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
controles.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
controles.livre: conforme o que está escrito no livro das palavras do profeta Isaías: “Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai as suas veredas.

versos.grego: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς ταπεινωθήσεται, καὶ ἔσται τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς εὐθείας καὶ αἱ τραχεῖαι εἰς ὁδοὺς λείας·

controles.web: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
controles.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
controles.livre: Todo vale se encherá, e todo monte e colina se abaixará; os tortos serão endireitados, e os caminhos ásperos se suavizarão;

versos.grego: καὶ ὄψεται πᾶσα σὰρξ τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
controles.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
controles.livre: e todos verão  a salvação de Deus.”

versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν οὖν τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ὄχλοις βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;

controles.web: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
controles.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
controles.livre: João dizia às multidões que vinham ser batizadas por ele: “Raça de víboras, quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira que está para chegar?

versos.grego: ποιήσατε οὖν καρποὺς ἀξίους τῆς μετανοίας· καὶ μὴ ἄρξησθε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ· λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.

controles.web: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
controles.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
controles.livre: Dai, pois, frutos condizentes com o arrependimento, e não comeceis a dizer em vós mesmos: ‘Temos Abraão por pai’; pois eu vos digo que até destas pedras Deus pode produzir  filhos a Abraão.

versos.grego: ἤδη δὲ καὶ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

controles.web: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.”
controles.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
controles.livre: E também o machado já está posto à raiz das árvores; portanto, toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι λέγοντες Τί οὖν ποιήσωμεν;

controles.web: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
controles.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
controles.livre: E as multidões lhe perguntavam: Então o que devemos fazer?

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ὁ ἔχων δύο χιτῶνας μεταδότω τῷ μὴ ἔχοντι, καὶ ὁ ἔχων βρώματα ὁμοίως ποιείτω.

controles.web: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
controles.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
controles.livre: E ele lhes respondeu: Quem tiver duas túnicas, reparta com o não tem; e quem tiver comida, faça da mesma maneira.

versos.grego: ἦλθον δὲ καὶ τελῶναι βαπτισθῆναι καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν Διδάσκαλε, τί ποιήσωμεν;

controles.web: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
controles.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
controles.livre: E chegaram também uns cobradores de impostos, para serem batizados; e disseram-lhe: Mestre, que devemos fazer?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Μηδὲν πλέον παρὰ τὸ διατεταγμένον ὑμῖν πράσσετε.

controles.web: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Não exijais mais do que vos está ordenado.

versos.grego: ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν καὶ στρατευόμενοι λέγοντες Τί ποιήσωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς; καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μηδένα διασείσητε μηδὲ συκοφαντήσητε, καὶ ἀρκεῖσθε τοῖς ὀψωνίοις ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?”   He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
controles.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
controles.livre: E uns soldados também lhe perguntaram: E nós, que devemos fazer? E ele lhes disse: Não maltrateis nem defraudeis a ninguém; e contentai-vos com vossos salários.

versos.grego: Προσδοκῶντος δὲ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ διαλογιζομένων πάντων ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ Ἰωάνου, μή ποτε αὐτὸς εἴη ὁ Χριστός,

controles.web: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
controles.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
controles.livre: E, enquanto o povo estava em expectativa, e todos pensando em seus corações se talvez João seria o Cristo,

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίνατο λέγων πᾶσιν ὁ Ἰωάνης Ἐγὼ μὲν ὕδατι βαπτίζω ὑμᾶς· ἔρχεται δὲ ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί·

controles.web: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,
controles.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
controles.livre: João respondeu a todos: De fato, eu vos batizo com água, mas vem um que é mais poderoso do que eu, de quem eu não sou digno de desatar a tira das sandálias; ele vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.

versos.grego: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ διακαθᾶραι τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συναγαγεῖν τὸν σῖτον εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην αὐτοῦ, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.

controles.web: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
controles.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
controles.livre: Sua pá está na sua mão para limpar sua eira, e para juntar o trigo no seu celeiro; porém queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apaga.

versos.grego: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἕτερα παρακαλῶν εὐηγγελίζετο τὸν λαόν·

controles.web: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
controles.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
controles.livre: Assim, exortando com muitas outras coisas, João anunciava a boa notícia ao povo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης, ἐλεγχόμενος ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ περὶ Ἡρῳδιάδος τῆς γυναικὸς τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν πονηρῶν ὁ Ἡρῴδης,

controles.web: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s  wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
controles.kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
controles.livre: Porém, quando Herodes, o tetrarca, foi repreendido por ele por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão, e por todas as maldades que Herodes havia feito,

versos.grego: προσέθηκεν καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ πᾶσιν, κατέκλεισεν τὸν Ἰωάνην ἐν φυλακῇ.

controles.web: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
controles.kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
controles.livre: acrescentou a todas ainda esta: encarcerou João na prisão.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ βαπτισθῆναι ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν καὶ Ἰησοῦ βαπτισθέντος καὶ προσευχομένου ἀνεῳχθῆναι τὸν οὐρανὸν,

controles.web: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,
controles.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando todo o povo era batizado, Jesus também foi batizado, e enquanto orava, o céu se abriu,

versos.grego: καὶ καταβῆναι τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον σωματικῷ εἴδει ὡς περιστερὰν ἐπ’ αὐτόν, καὶ φωνὴν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ γενέσθαι Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.

controles.web: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form as a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
controles.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
controles.livre: e o Espírito Santo desceu sobre ele em forma corpórea, como pomba; e veio do céu uma voz: Tu és o meu Filho amado, em ti me agrado.

versos.grego: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν Ἰησοῦς ἀρχόμενος ὡσεὶ ἐτῶν τριάκοντα, ὢν υἱός, ὡς ἐνομίζετο, Ἰωσὴφ, τοῦ Ἡλεὶ

controles.web: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
controles.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
controles.livre: E o mesmo Jesus começou quando tinha cerca de trinta anos, sendo (como se pensava) filho de José, filho de Eli,

versos.grego: τοῦ Ματθὰτ τοῦ Λευεὶ τοῦ Μελχεὶ τοῦ Ἰανναὶ τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ

controles.web: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
controles.livre: filho de Matate, filho de Levi, filho de Melqui, filho de Janai, filho de José.

versos.grego: τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Ἀμὼς τοῦ Ναοὺμ τοῦ Ἐσλεὶ τοῦ Ναγγαὶ

controles.web: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
controles.livre: filho de Matatias, filho de Amós, filho de Naum, filho de Esli, filho de Nagai.

versos.grego: τοῦ Μαὰθ τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Σεμεεὶν τοῦ Ἰωσὴχ τοῦ Ἰωδὰ

controles.web: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
controles.livre: filho de Maate, filho de Matatias, filho de Semei, filho de Joseque, filho de Jodá.

versos.grego: τοῦ Ἰωανὰν τοῦ Ῥησὰ τοῦ Ζοροβάβελ τοῦ Σαλαθιὴλ τοῦ Νηρεὶ

controles.web: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
controles.livre: filho de Joanã, filho de Resa, filho de Zorobabel, e filho de Salatiel, filho de Neri.

versos.grego: τοῦ Μελχεὶ τοῦ Ἀδδεὶ τοῦ Κωσὰμ τοῦ Ἐλμαδὰμ τοῦ Ἢρ

controles.web: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
controles.livre: filho de Melqui, filho de Adi, e filho de Cosã, filho de Elmodã, filho de Er.

versos.grego: τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ἐλιέζερ τοῦ Ἰωρεὶμ τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευεὶ

controles.web: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
controles.livre: filho de Josué,filho de Eliézer, filho de Jorim, filho de Matate, filho de Levi.

versos.grego: τοῦ Συμεὼν τοῦ Ἰούδα τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἰωνὰμ τοῦ Ἐλιακεὶμ

controles.web: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
controles.livre: filho de Simeão, filho de Judá, filho de José, filho de Jonã, filho de Eliaquim.

versos.grego: τοῦ Μελεὰ τοῦ Μεννὰ τοῦ Ματταθὰ τοῦ Ναθὰμ τοῦ Δαυεὶδ

controles.web: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
controles.livre: filho de Meleá, filho de Mená, filho de Matatá, filho de Natã, filho de Davi.

versos.grego: τοῦ Ἰεσσαὶ τοῦ Ἰωβὴδ τοῦ Βοὸς τοῦ Σαλὰ τοῦ Ναασσὼν

controles.web: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
controles.livre: Filho de Jessé, filho de Obede, filho de Boaz, filho de Salá, filho de Naassom.

versos.grego: τοῦ Ἀμιναδὰβ τοῦ Ἀδμεὶν τοῦ Ἀρνεὶ τοῦ Ἐσρὼμ τοῦ Φαρὲς τοῦ Ἰούδα

controles.web: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
controles.livre: Filho de Aminadabe, filho de Admin, filho de Arni,  filho de Esrom, filho de Peres, filho de Judá.

versos.grego: τοῦ Ἰακὼβ τοῦ Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ τοῦ Θάρα τοῦ Ναχὼρ

controles.web: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
controles.livre: filho de Jacó, filho de Isaque, filho de Abraão, filho de Terá, filho de Naor.

versos.grego: τοῦ Σεροὺχ τοῦ Ῥαγαῦ τοῦ Φάλεκ τοῦ Ἔβερ τοῦ Σαλὰ

controles.web: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
controles.livre: filho de Serugue, filho de Ragaú, filho de Faleque, filho de Éber, filho de Salá.

versos.grego: τοῦ Καϊνὰμ τοῦ Ἀρφαξὰδ τοῦ Σὴμ τοῦ Νῶε τοῦ Λάμεχ

controles.web: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
controles.livre: Filho de Cainã, filho de Arfaxade, filho de Sem, filho de Noé, filho de Lameque.

versos.grego: τοῦ Μαθουσαλὰ τοῦ Ἐνὼχ τοῦ Ἰάρετ τοῦ Μαλελεὴλ τοῦ Καϊνὰμ

controles.web: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
controles.livre: Filho de Matusalém, filho de Enoque, filho de Jarede, filho de Maleleel, filho de Cainã.

versos.grego: τοῦ Ἐνὼς τοῦ Σὴθ τοῦ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
controles.kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
controles.livre: filho de Enos, filho de Sete, filho de Adão, e Adão de Deus.
